🦜 Potential development areas near main roads and schools (Tartu)

Project: warning Validation: warning

Analytical Objective

Find cadastral parcels in the Tartu region satisfying stated land-use, minimum size (>= 2 ha), primary road accessibility (<= 2000 m), and a documented 2,000 m straight-line accessibility proxy to both verified municipal kindergarten and school locations.

Multi-Criteria Suitability Results

130 Prime Parcels (Road + School + KG within 2 km proxy)
3185.1 ha Prime Suitable Area
518 Total Accessible Parcels (in Tartu linn)
9570.8 ha Total Evaluated Area

Map Legend & Layers

Tier 1 Prime: Road ≤2km & School+KG within 2 km straight-line proxy
Tier 2 Good: Road ≤2km & School or KG within 2 km straight-line proxy
Tier 3: Road access only (>2 km straight-line proxy to school/KG)
Municipal schools: 2 km straight-line proxy
Municipal kindergartens: 2 km straight-line proxy

Official National Highways (Põhimaantee/Tugimaantee)
Hypothetical Connector Road (OVERRIDE-002)

Analytical Constraints & Criteria

  • • Minimum Area: ≥ 20 000 m² (2.0 ha) measured in EPSG:3301 (L-EST97)
  • • Land-use (siht1): Agricultural, Production, or Commercial in Tartu linn (79,056 county parcels evaluated)
  • • Highway Accessibility: ≤ 2 000 m planar distance to official primary/secondary highway or hypothetical scenario connector
  • • Education Proxy: ≤ 2,000 m straight-line distance to verified active municipal school and kindergarten; not a network isochrone

Assumptions

  • A1 — "Near a main road" is interpreted as <= 2000 m planar distance to a national primary (Põhimaantee) or secondary (Tugimaantee) road or hypothetical scenario connector.
  • A2 — Parcel area is measured in EPSG:3301 (L-EST97).
  • A3 — The requested "25 minutes walking access" is represented only as a 2,000 m planar straight-line proxy based on 4.8 km/h (80 m/min); it is not a pedestrian-network isochrone.

Project Overrides (1)

  • OVERRIDE-002 (add_feature) — Demonstration-only hypothetical connector used to show how a scenario changes accessibility. It is not asserted to be an approved or planned road.
